</> CodeFlow

Master Web Development Online

Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks from industry experts. Start your coding journey today.

Enroll Now

Why Choose CodeFlow?

Self-Paced Learning

Study whenever you want, wherever you want. Access all course materials 24/7 and progress at your own speed.

Expert Instructors

Learn from experienced web developers with over 50 years of combined industry experience and proven teaching records.

Real-World Projects

Build portfolio projects that showcase your skills to potential employers. Every lesson connects to practical applications.

Lifetime Access

Enroll once and access course content forever. Receive free updates as new technologies and best practices emerge.

Community Support

Connect with thousands of learners, ask questions in our forums, and get feedback from instructors and peers.

Certificate of Completion

Earn a recognized certificate upon completing the course to add credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile.

Comprehensive Curriculum

Master web development through 12 progressive modules covering everything from basics to advanced topics.

Module 1: HTML Foundations

2 weeks

Learn semantic HTML5, form elements, accessibility best practices, and how to structure web pages properly.

  • HTML document structure
  • Semantic elements and accessibility
  • Forms and input validation
  • Meta tags and SEO basics

Module 2: CSS Styling & Layout

3 weeks

Master CSS selectors, styling techniques, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, and modern animation methods.

  • CSS selectors and cascading
  • Flexbox and CSS Grid
  • Responsive design and media queries
  • Animations and transitions

Module 3: JavaScript Basics

3 weeks

Build a strong foundation in JavaScript fundamentals, variables, functions, and object-oriented programming.

  • Variables, data types, and operators
  • Functions and scope
  • Objects and arrays
  • DOM manipulation

Module 4: Advanced JavaScript

3 weeks

Explore async programming, callbacks, promises, async/await, and event handling for interactive web applications.

  • Callbacks and promises
  • Async/await patterns
  • Event handling and listeners
  • Error handling and debugging

Module 5: React Fundamentals

4 weeks

Learn React components, JSX, state management, hooks, and how to build modern single-page applications.

  • Components and JSX
  • Props and state
  • React hooks (useState, useEffect)
  • Component lifecycle

Module 6: Advanced React & State Management

3 weeks

Master Context API, Redux, custom hooks, performance optimization, and best practices for scaling React applications.

  • Context API and prop drilling solutions
  • Redux fundamentals
  • Custom hooks and hook patterns
  • Performance optimization

Module 7: Web APIs & Backend Basics

2 weeks

Understand HTTP, REST APIs, fetch, local storage, and how to communicate between frontend and backend services.

  • HTTP methods and status codes
  • Fetch API and AJAX
  • REST API design principles
  • Local storage and sessions

Module 8: Node.js & Express

3 weeks

Build server-side applications with Node.js and Express, handle middleware, routing, and basic database integration.

  • Node.js runtime and npm
  • Express server setup
  • Routing and middleware
  • Database connectivity

Module 9: Databases & SQL

2 weeks

Learn relational databases, SQL queries, MongoDB, data modeling, and how to manage data in web applications.

  • SQL fundamentals
  • Database design and normalization
  • MongoDB and NoSQL
  • ORMs and query builders

Module 10: Authentication & Security

2 weeks

Implement user authentication, JWT tokens, password hashing, secure API design, and protect against common vulnerabilities.

  • User authentication patterns
  • JWT and session management
  • Password hashing and encryption
  • Security best practices and OWASP

Module 11: Testing & Deployment

2 weeks

Write unit and integration tests, deploy applications to production, use CI/CD pipelines, and monitor performance.

  • Unit testing and Jest
  • Integration testing
  • Deployment platforms (Vercel, Heroku)
  • CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions

Module 12: Capstone Project

4 weeks

Apply all skills to build a complete full-stack web application with frontend, backend, database, and deployment.

  • Project planning and architecture
  • Full-stack development workflow
  • Code review and best practices
  • Final deployment and portfolio presentation
32 Weeks Total Course Duration
